name: Three Beat Freight
description: Program three commands, intercept cargo and return to your dock. Play solo dispatches or resolve hidden plans together in real private rooms.
features: Twelve original freight yards and 24 playable solo contracts
Shared deterministic rules for simultaneous movement, shoves, belts and delivery
Real two-to-four-player rooms with private locked plans and server-owned results
Explicitly labeled local automated rival and a date-selected daily dispatch
Beat-by-beat replays, reconnect, fresh rematches and portable replay files
Visual arena editor with validation, local files and three free private cloud slots
Optional larger cloud locker through Polar; advertising requires publisher and real consent setup
businessHypothesis: Repeat play, human interception and shared custom yards may encourage return visits and friend invitations. An optional Polar subscription expands private cloud arena capacity without selling a gameplay advantage. AdSense is prepared behind real publisher and consent-management configuration. Live payment, advertising fill, enjoyment, audience growth and revenue have not been established.
